content.text: Bell Bike Helmets: a legacy of protection At Bell, we know that cyclists of all skill levels and riding styles all want the best in head protection. This is why we've been at the forefront of helmet innovation since 1954. From road racing to enduro riding, Bell is the first name in helmet safety, getting you from point A to Z with confidence. No matter if you're tearing down technical mountain bike trails or racing on the open road, Bell offers a wide selection of premium bike helmets that deliver the perfect combination of advanced safety technology and lightweight, aerodynamic designs. Pioneering Helmet Technology Bell was founded in 1954 by Roy Richter. Since then, our brand has become a trailblazer in the world of cycling and motorsport helmet design. Our commitment to innovation has led to many of the industry standards you see today. From introducing the first full-face helmet to pioneering cutting-edge safety features like MIPS and Spherical Technology, Bell has always been dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in helmet design. Our brand focuses on research and development, which ensures that every Bell helmet not only meets but exceeds expectations in terms of functionality, protection, and fit. Off-road Protection for Challenging Trails Bell's MTB and Enduro bike helmets are a choice that will not fail during our riders’ off-road adventures. Created with the rugged terrains our riders face in mind, Bell’s bike helmets are equipped with pro-level technologies that elevate your off-road experience while providing the level of safety required for these disciplines. Bell’s mountain bike helmets feature the FIDLOCK® adjustment system. These allow for a secure and snug fit. Moreover, optimized padding and a 3-position visor to enhance comfort and ventilation, keep you cool and dry during the most intense of rides. These helmets also integrate seamlessly with most goggles, assuring enhanced compatibility and a sleek look. Our MTB and Enduro helmets are not just about protection; they’re about performance. The lightweight construction ensures that you’re not weighed down, while the innovative design allows for optimal ventilation, so you stay comfortable no matter how challenging the trail gets. Road Cycling: Light, Strong, and Aerodynamic For road cyclists, a bike helmet needs to be more than just protective—it needs to be efficient. Bell’s adult cycling helmets are engineered to provide high-level protection without sacrificing performance. With a lightweight and aerodynamic design, these bike helmets are madedesigned to keep you cool on long ascents, and won’t slow you down during sprints. The inclusion of MIPS technology adds an extra layer of safety by managing rotational forces that can occur during certain impacts, which is extra important when you are riding at higher speeds. Many Bell road helmets also feature a detachable 30-lumen LED rear light with multiple modes, ensuring commuters and urban cyclers they’re visible to traffic during nighttime and foggy settings. Whether No matter if you’re love training on winding roads or enjoyingor just enjoying a chilled ride, our adult cycling helmets offer the perfect balance of protection, comfort, and performance. Safety and Comfort for Young Riders At Bell, we want parents to have peace of mind during all of their children’s cycling experiences. That’s why our kids' bike helmets are designed with the same advanced technologies as our adult helmets. Many models feature MIPS technology, providing an extra layer of protection against rotational impacts. Our children’s helmets also come with a removable visor and ergonomic fit, making them perfect for growing adventurers. Our helmets for the smallest riders feature fun, colorful graphics that kids will love, combined with a practical design that parents appreciate. The side buckle is designed to prevent pinching and can be adjusted quickly and easily to fit any head. With Bell, you can trust that your child is protected and comfortable, no matter where their next ride takes them. MIPS Technology: Advanced Protection for Every Rider One of the standout features in many Bell helmets is MIPS, or Multi-Directional Impact Protection System. This innovative technology is designed to provide an additional layer of protection by managing the energy from rotational and angular impacts. When a head rotates quickly and comes to a sudden stop, the brain can experience high levels of strain, potentially leading to brain injury. MIPS technology helps reduce this strain by allowing the helmet’s outer shell to rotate independently of the inner liner, mimicking the brain’s natural defense system. This slip-plane system is designed to slow or reduce the amount of energy transferred to the head, potentially reducing the risk and severity of brain injuries. By incorporating MIPS into our products, Bell is taking helmet safety to the next level, providing riders with the security and protection they need for every ride.
